title: The Harbor of the Old Mill House
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Casper Voss, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
